meta.title: AI Financing Map
meta.description: Directional money flows between chip suppliers, hyperscalers, neoclouds, frontier labs, investors, lenders and developers. From = outflow, To = inflow. Amounts are $bn unless a quantity is given.
meta.warning: Do NOT sum all rows into a single total. Filter Is_Aggregate=No and Is_Component=No for company sums, filter Status before summing (Closed vs Committed vs Contingent vs LOI are different stages), and never add a lab's equity to that lab's cloud commitments to the same supplier - the same dollar circulates.
meta.source: Derived from the AI financing research report (36 relationships) and its spreadsheet dataset. Full source URLs are in the library markdown report.
